statement: NVIDIA signed memorandums of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish compute financing platforms intended to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure.
why: Financing availability is the binding constraint for the marginal AI-infrastructure buyer, so dedicated capital pools at attractive rates directly loosen who can afford to order accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Third-party capital pools underwrite GPU purchases by frontier labs, enterprises and AI clouds, converting compute into a financeable asset and easing the credit constraint on marginal orders.

evidence.excerpt: to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital
to create dedicated pools of capital at significant scale at attractive rates for NVIDIA customers.

confidence.basis: Primary company press release on NVIDIA investor relations naming the six counterparties and the target capital figure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: NVIDIA Newsroom / investor.nvidia.com (official press release)
